_methodology: Fixed instruction TEMPLATES are translated once per language (not per-task-instance), holding task difficulty constant across languages so language is the only varying factor. Each translation was produced and then independently back-translated to English by the same process; back_translation is compared to source_en to catch semantic drift. confidence is a self-reported estimate of translation reliability, not a formal metric -- see notes. Slots ({start_x} etc.) must remain literal placeholders substituted at runtime; numeric coordinates are kept as digits in every language (standard practice, not a translation gap).
